references.text: Mentions cities of refuge to be given to the Levites, including cities for someone who killed another unintentionally
Hebron is designated as a city of refuge in the hill country of Judah
Hebron was given to Caleb, but the Levitical cities were set apart from this area
Commands that the Levites are to receive cities with their surrounding pasturelands
The context for why Aaron's descendants received cities, because the lot fell to them first
